classifications.already_integrated: Tip is an ancestor of the trunk, or every change is present verbatim.
classifications.integrated_via_equivalent: Changes exist on the trunk through an equivalent implementation (verified by normalised diff, test slug/content match, or behaviour).
classifications.missing_recoverable: Valuable work not on the trunk that is safe to recover or review.
classifications.missing_conflict: Valuable work not on the trunk whose recovery needs conflict resolution or an owner decision.
classifications.superseded: Replaced by later trunk work or documents; nothing worth recovering.
classifications.intentionally_removed: Removed on purpose; must not be restored.
classifications.unknown_owner_review: Cannot be classified without the owner; NOT recovered.
classifications.infrastructure_ledger: Release ledger / infrastructure ref, not feature work.
